articles.title: Netflix at QConSF 2026: Retrofitting the SDLC for AI Coding Agents
articles.summary: At QCon San Francisco 2026, Mark Khuzam of Netflix explained how the Commerce team retrofitted its SDLC so AI coding agents and engineers could ship together. The team wrote 45 architecture decision r...
articles.description: At QCon San Francisco 2026, Mark Khuzam of Netflix explained how the Commerce team retrofitted its SDLC so AI coding agents and engineers could ship together. The team wrote 45 architecture decision records for people and agents, added a review agent that posts only verified blockers, and serves per-domain GraphRAG context through a single MCP tool. By Andrew Hoblitzell

articles.title: Agoda Reduces API Code Review Time by 64% with Modular Architecture
articles.summary: Agoda introduced a modular monolith framework in its post-booking API to reduce coupling without a full rewrite. The platform uses domain components, Data Mapper patterns, typed builders, and ArchUnit...
articles.description: Agoda introduced a modular monolith framework in its post-booking API to reduce coupling without a full rewrite. The platform uses domain components, Data Mapper patterns, typed builders, and ArchUnit tests to enforce boundaries. Framework-backed changes showed 64% shorter median code reviews and 34% faster initial feedback than legacy changes. By Leela Kumili
